messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — spike of 429s observed for tenant `atlasrx` in eu-west-1 (dedicated pool id: pool-32a). 429 rate 180/s over last 2m, baseline ~5/s. Auto-throttle engaged.

sara: oncall here. looking now. is this going to customer-facing errors or internal retries?

mike: seeing 429s from atlasrx service keys (~95% of errors). client reports degraded realtime scoring. sample logs: `2026-03-15T12:02:10Z atlasrx svc: request rejected status=429 tokens=24`

ryan: checking pool health — GPUs at 42% util, no node failures. this looks quota-related at tenant layer not infra.

kt: pinging CS — @julie can you confirm what atlasrx is running? bursty batch or realtime? any recent config/rollout?

julie: atlasrx on enterprise contract w/ reserved qps = 50. they were told burst up to 200/day previously during launch window. no recent deploys on their side. they're doing CSV imports this morning (we were warned) but should still be under reserved.

sara: ok. hypothesis: they started a large import hitting per-second limits, auto-throttle cut over. we need a temporary override to avoid customer outages while we investigate noisy neighbour or billing mismatch.

mike: agree. recommend immediate temporary rate-exemption (emergency lift) scoped to tenant `atlasrx` with TTL 1h and audit note. prepared admin API call if approved.

julie: sales approves emergency 1hr lift for customer success to finish import. will sign off on audit note.

sara: ryan / mike, do it. make it tenant-scoped, do not change pool defaults. add a rollback timer.

ryan: applying override now. command: ```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood-internal/api/v1/tenant-overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_ADMIN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"atlasrx","override":{"qps":250},"ttl_seconds":3600,"reason":"Emergency customer lift - CSV import - approved by sales"}'
```

ryan: api returned 200 OK. override id `ovr-20260315-9f3`. change propagated to routing layer, should be immediate.

mike: verification queries: `select count(*) from rate_events where tenant='atlasrx' and status=429 and ts > now() - interval '5 minutes';` shows 429s dropping from 180/s -> 6/s within 45s. good.

kt: tagging on-call handoff: sara handing to kt in 30m for watch. kt youre up for next 60m. please monitor metrics and customer slack channel.

sara: handing off early — I've created a dedicated watch dashboard: /dashboards/atlasrx-rate-watch, alerts set for 429 > 10/s sustained for 2m. also created an incident checklist item: investigate per-client token usage + possible leaky retry loops.

kt: got it. will keep 15min checks. can someone open a short postmortem ticket and link to incident? need follow-up: 1) confirm contract qps vs code behavior, 2) consider per-key burst smoothing, 3) add guardrail for imports.

julie: i'll coordinate with atlasrx PM to confirm expected import patterns and invoice/contract wording.

mike: note — we saw a single client key within atlasrx account making 90% of calls, long tail otherwise. flagged for CS to check. potential misconfigured worker.

ryan: rolling back plan: override will auto-expire in 1h. i've also created a short-lived metric alert to notify if CPU/GPU > 70% or if 429 > 20/s after rollback window.

incident-bot: Incident updated — severity: high -> mitigated. Mitigation action: tenant override applied (ovr-20260315-9f3). Next action: oncall handoff to kt at 2026-03-15T12:40:10Z.

kt: logging acknowledgement. will keep monitoring and escalate if 429s resurge. will open a follow-up thread for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

sara: thanks team. add customer-facing note to atlasrx slack/Ticket #1257 that we applied emergency lift and investigating root cause.

julie: will update ticket and schedule 1:1 with customer this afternoon.

mike: postmortem owner assigned: mike. ETA EOD tomorrow for draft. add checklist item to verify admin APIs have SSO audit and that emergency lifts require 2-person approval for >2hr TTL.

kt: closing monitoring loop — 429s stable at ~3-4/s. leaving dashboard pinned.

sara: handed off. closing thread; leave open for postmortem updates. :lock:
